interfacePlanning.environmentSeparation: 07 §4 gives a candidate single-writer AWS topology: dev may use local PostgreSQL 17 + S3-compatible compose only as a test environment; staging and production require independent accounts or at minimum isolated roles, buckets, DBs, KMS and callbacks. Region/domain are read from environment/workspace decisions; us-east-1 is a candidate, not a selected production region. No multi-writer topology or IaC state/backend is selected.
interfacePlanning.serviceTopology: Plan API and worker as separate processes running the same release version, one write region, bounded HTTP/S3 concurrency, pg-boss for idempotent jobs, and no DB row lock held over S3/payment network calls. The specification caps each service DB pool at 10; replica counts and the aggregate connection budget remain OPEN_QUESTION and must prevent scale-out from exceeding DB capacity.
interfacePlanning.databaseAndMigration: Readiness checks process liveness separately from migration version, DB and required dependencies. Plan expand/contract compatibility across release versions; binary rollback must not automatically reverse a DB migration or delete newer data. Migration framework, lock/timeout and exact supported old/new version window remain OPEN_QUESTION.
interfacePlanning.privateObjectStore: Plan private S3 access and member-authorized signed downloads; account/environment separation is explicit. Actual provider version/delete semantics, KMS mapping, URL lifetime, retention and evidence for physical-version accounting remain owned by accepted storage contracts and OPEN_QUESTION where not frozen. Local S3-compatible success cannot stand for AWS conditional-write/CopyObject behavior.
interfacePlanning.artifactAndUpdate: Plan a per-platform artifact identity/provenance record that can link platform, release channel, version, build commit, artifact digest and signature-verification result without containing a signature secret or private key. Windows, macOS, iOS and Android are separate gates. The actual signature formats, trust roots, update metadata, anti-rollback, notarization/store rules and manifest fields remain OPEN_QUESTION; no signing operation is planned here.
interfacePlanning.compatibilityAndRollback: Use compatibility fixtures for current/previous client and expand/contract schema combinations. Keep old data intact on binary rollback; an old binary's write behavior against a new schema, allowed version window, rollback trigger/owner and partial-update UI state remain OPEN_QUESTION. Do not infer an automatic inverse migration.
interfacePlanning.featureFlagsAndRollout: 07 §7 freezes channel order internal→closed beta→public beta→paid stable and version-scoped flags for cloud, autoPaste and purchase entry. Plan each capability to be independently stoppable while preserving local access; exact flag authority/cache, cohort sizes, stage duration, promotion thresholds, abort owner and stale-control behavior remain OPEN_QUESTION. Production promotion is never automatic in this plan.
interfacePlanning.secretBoundary: Signing/distribution keys belong in protected CI secrets and must not appear in source, normal task output, logs, caches or artifacts. AWS Secret Manager is only the 07 topology candidate; provider, workload identity, rotation/revocation, approvers and audit/retention policy are not selected. Fixtures use synthetic canary markers and assert only absent/present categories, never record marker values.
interfacePlanning.telemetryAndAlerting: Only count/type/duration/error-code style product events are described by 07 §7; content, URL, title, source trail and image are excluded. 08 §3 also excludes keys, tokens and unsanitized SQL parameters from telemetry/crash. Plan worker lag, pending upload, ledger drift, snapshot failure, RLS refusal, input failure and sync error alarms. Exact telemetry allow-list/retention/consent, alert thresholds, windows, routing and escalation are OPEN_QUESTION.
interfacePlanning.operationalRecovery: For S25, plan a restore only into an isolated target, validate counts/heads/checksums and deletion fences without exposing user content, keep serving/writes closed until reconciliation is complete, then follow the accepted T29 restore/epoch/fresh-bootstrap contract. T29 G07 owns the production-equivalent PG/object recovery evidence; T30 cannot replace it or infer a restore DTO/RPO/RTO.
interfacePlanning.supportDiagnostics: Synthetic diagnostics may plan environment/build, operation category, redacted error category and a support correlation reference only after an allow-list is frozen. No content, URL, title, source, image, credentials, token, key, signature, raw body or unredacted SQL parameters. Exact collection consent, fields, retention and customer workflow remain OPEN_QUESTION.
interfacePlanning.costReport: Plan symbolic low/base/high workload scenarios and a per-active-account model covering actual object GB-month, object/request counts, egress, PG/API/worker, staging and pending data, trash/versions, backups/logs, payment and support costs, including cipher overhead. Do not cross-account deduplicate or expose content hashes. 10 GiB is a candidate capacity for sensitivity analysis, not a grant, price or promise. No provider price, currency, region multiplier, workload population or commercial conclusion is invented.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: dev/staging/prod分离；IaC仅计划预览，不apply、不创建计费资源；candidate region不冒充已选region。
API/worker分进程、同版本、单写区域；pool与扩容遵循冻结连接预算，健康检查区分进程与依赖。
迁移按expand/contract兼容窗口规划；二进制回滚不自动逆迁移或删除新版数据。
pg-boss任务幂等；业务账本/事务边界不因远程S3调用持行锁。
对象存储私有且环境/账号隔离；授权下载和对象账本不因失败、待处理或未确认删除而提前释放。
Win/macOS/iOS/Android签名artifact分别规划与验收，不以单平台或合成metadata替代实际签名。
更新元数据与artifact相互绑定；篡改/非法签名不安装、不推进版本；具体trust protocol保持未冻结。
升级/回滚按应用版本与schema组合验兼容；中断更新不假报完成；不自动反向迁移。
cloud、autoPaste、purchase入口可独立停用；本地访问继续；灰度顺序固定且不自动发布production。
签名/分发秘密只经批准的受保护secret边界注入，不进入仓库、日志、缓存、artifact或普通任务输出。
telemetry/crash/诊断排除内容、URL、标题、来源、图片、token、key、凭证、签名和未脱敏SQL参数。
计划worker lag、pending upload、ledger drift、snapshot fail、RLS拒绝、input failure与sync error告警且告警无内容泄漏。
S25恢复仅隔离执行；证据不完整时不开放服务，恢复核验不输出用户内容，并依赖T29实证。
支持诊断与操作runbook覆盖错误/取消/容量/权限，避免索取或输出敏感用户数据。
成本/容量模型覆盖07 §5成本项、cipher overhead、10GiB候选敏感性分析且不伪造价格或商业结论。
权限/取消/容量/签名/迁移/基础设施失败不形成假绿、不开放未批准能力，具体错误映射未知时保留OPEN_QUESTION。
任何production发布都需要当时明确授权；计划/CI不得自动发布生产。
critical行为实现及真实隔离证据完成后必须独立对抗审查；静态fixture自检不替代审查或accepted。

limitations: Planning only: 36 synthetic fixtures, 16 gates, 3 card commands, 5 measurement plans, 24 OPEN_QUESTION items and 3 deferred scenarios; every fixture/gate/command/measurement is NOT_RUN with empty evidence.

Direct dependencies T25/T27/T28/T29 are not accepted. No infrastructure, IaC plan/apply, cloud/database/S3/provider/store account, signing identity, secret, real telemetry/support sink, release, rollback or S25 recovery operation was used.

No behavior test, build, typecheck, clippy, release check or command readiness probe was executed. The root package does not declare pnpm release:check or pnpm -r typecheck; commands remain NOT_RUN, not silently replaced.

AWS/ECS/Fargate/RDS PostgreSQL 17/private S3/CloudFront/Secret Manager remain candidate topology only; production region/domain/account and IaC implementation are unknown. Local compose cannot substitute for provider behavior.

Per-service DB pool maximum 10 is frozen in 07 §4; aggregate connection budget, autoscaling, migration/version window, pg-boss retry, storage-provider semantics and update/signing contracts remain OPEN_QUESTION.

Win/macOS/iOS/Android signatures, macOS notarization, store packaging/review, update installation/rollback, gray release, feature-flag runtime behavior and production authorization remain NOT_RUN. No platform result can stand in for another.

S25 production-equivalent recovery requires T29-G07 acceptance and a later real isolated T30-G13 rehearsal; T25-D02 remains open. T29 owns S27 import/export and local-only recovery; T25-D03 remains open until its own gate.

No telemetry/alert/support canary was executed. No canary values, content, credentials or costs are stored. Telemetry and support allow-list, thresholds, retention and cost inputs remain open as listed.
This author structural self-check does not satisfy the required independent critical review, behavior acceptance, platform evidence, or task accepted status.
